changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.01[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]Real-Debrid[/COLOR]
-Updated to the filename rule Real-Debrid applies since 3 October 2026. WEBRip, BDRip, HDRip and DVDRip releases, BluRay.x264, BluRay.DTS and WEB.h264 with a lowercase h are served again and are back in the source list.
-Real-Debrid now refuses only names containing WEB-DL, WEB.x264, WEB.H264, HDTV.x264 or HDTV.XviD, written exactly that way. The filter now matches them case-sensitively, so names such as web-dl or WEB.h264 are no longer hidden.
-Real-Debrid checks the torrent's name when it is added and each file's own name when it is played. Both are now checked: a result whose folder or video file Real-Debrid would refuse is left out of the list, and an episode it refuses inside a pack is skipped without asking Real-Debrid for it.
-Browsing a pack no longer lists the files Real-Debrid refuses to stream.
-Real-Debrid sometimes refuses every new torrent on an account for a while, with the same answer it gives for a refused name. luc_kodi now tells the two apart: it says so once, never over a video that is playing, and holds Real-Debrid for 30 seconds instead of trying every Real-Debrid source in turn.
-My Torrents lists only the files selected in each torrent, each with its own link, and Delete Torrent removes the torrent instead of being sent the id of a file inside it.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-Real-Debrid could play the wrong file, or fail with an unsupported file, when a torrent listed a text, info or subtitle file before the video. Each file now gets its own link.
-When Real-Debrid has packed a torrent into a single archive, or some of its links have expired, playback and pack browsing say so instead of trying a link that does not match the file.
-Real-Debrid My Torrents and My Downloads open correctly when they are empty or Real-Debrid does not answer, instead of leaving Kodi waiting on the folder.
-A refused Real-Debrid torrent no longer goes on to ask for the files of a torrent that was never created, and a file that could not be unrestricted, or came back as a .rar, logs the reason instead of an error.
-Server notifications for Real-Debrid, Premiumize and AllDebrid stay off when they are turned off in Settings. Before, they were shown either way.
